hero.badge: AI at the service of teams
hero.title: The smart tool for building <hl>high-performing</hl> <hl>teams</hl>
hero.subtitle: SARA analyses skills, experience and personality, and weighs them against how the project actually works — on-site, hybrid or remote — to recommend the ideal team and anticipate its risks.

features.title: Everything you need to build <hl>outstanding</hl> teams

analysis.title: End-to-end analysis
analysis.description: Assesses each candidate’s technical skills, experience and personality.

bigFive.title: Big Five model
bigFive.description: Uses the Big Five personality model to understand how well a team fits together.

recommendations.title: Smart recommendations
recommendations.description: Advanced algorithms that suggest the best teams for your project.

reports.title: Detailed reports
reports.description: Explore metrics and in-depth analysis to make better decisions.

workMode.title: Work model aware
workMode.description: From fully on-site to fully remote: every recommendation accounts for the work model, how spread out the team is and the time zones it spans.

riskMonitoring.title: Risks up front
riskMonitoring.description: Surfaces the risks distributed work brings — isolation, async communication breakdown, time-zone gaps — and tracks them as the project runs.

steps.title: A simple process for the best results

define.title: 1. Define your project
define.description: Describe the goals, the skills you need and how the team will work: work model, geographic spread and time zones.

evaluate.title: 2. Assess candidates
evaluate.description: SARA analyses CVs and personality with the Big Five model, alongside each candidate’s remote working experience.

recommend.title: 3. Get recommendations
recommend.description: Receive a team optimised for compatibility, skills and fit with the project’s work model.

decide.title: 4. Make better decisions
decide.description: Review reports, metrics and the predicted risks to build balanced, high-performing teams.

about.title: Stronger teams, <hl>more successful projects.</hl>
about.description: SARA helps you make data-driven decisions to build balanced, motivated teams ready to achieve great results.
